change_summary: Promoted a new runtime-validated sizing rule into production: `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` now applies `BREAKOUT_COMMS_NEAR_HIGH_RISK_MULTIPLIER = 0.25` only when `strategy == 'breakout_long'`, `sector == 'Communication Services'`, and `conditions_met.pct_from_52w_high >= -0.03`. Added a targeted unit test and kept the validating runner artifact. Entry logic, exit logic, ranking, sector cap, and blocked LLM/C branches stayed unchanged.

delta_metrics.note: The harsher 0.0x follow-up improved EV more, but it degraded drawdown and failed to improve sharpe in the live secondary comparison. The accepted 0.25x rule preserves the strict-null late-strong tape while improving EV, sharpe_daily, and max drawdown together in the weaker windows. This is a new breakout conditioning source (sector + entry shape), not a reopen of the exhausted sector+gap family.

hypothesis: After the accepted A+B stack plus the recent trend-Tech residual rules, the remaining breakout drag is concentrated in `breakout_long + Communication Services + pct_from_52w_high >= -0.03`. De-risking only that near-high pocket should stay a strict null in the dominant late-strong tape while improving the weaker mid/old windows, without reopening the exhausted sector+gap breakout family.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull / accepted A+B stack dominant tape
market_regime_summary.live_secondary: recent weaker comparison window with one qualifying Communication Services breakout
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull with weaker breakout follow-through

next_retry_requires: Do not reopen `0.25x` vs `0.0x` inside the same `breakout_long | Communication Services | pct_from_52w_high >= -3%` pocket by default
Do not reinterpret this as permission to restart broad breakout pullback ranking or another coarse Communication Services sector cut
If breakout residual allocation work continues, require another genuinely new conditioning source beyond the current sector+entry-shape pocket family
